_why: Duplicate of the repo-root .impeccable/config.json. The hook resolves config from the NEAREST .impeccable dir walking up from the scanned file — and v2/.impeccable already existed (it holds critique/ + hook.cache.json), so it shadowed the root config and every waiver written there was silently ignored for files under v2/. That is why the Inter flag kept re-firing after being 'fixed' three times.
